bio.text: Lorena García, a Democrat, represents District 35 (Adams and Jefferson counties) in the Colorado House of Representatives.
She has held the seat since 2023 and is a candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She earned a bachelor's degree in film, cinema and video studies from the University of Colorado Boulder in 2005 and an M.B.A. in international business from George Washington University in 2017.
Her career includes serving as Colorado state director for 9to5 and as executive director of the Colorado Organization for Latina Opportunity and Reproductive Rights.
